Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Enhanced Southwest Monsoon (Habagat) and Super Typhoon NANDO
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 22 September 2025(Monday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Cavite(Tanza, Trece Martires, Indang, Alfonso, Naic, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Magallanes, Ternate, Maragondon, Mendez, Tagaytay) and Batangas(Agoncillo, Alitagtag, Balayan, Balete, Bauan, Calaca, Calatagan, Tanauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Laurel, Lemery, Lian, Lipa, Mabini, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Nasugbu, Padre Garcia, San Jose, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Santo Tomas, Taal, Talisay, Tuy, Batangas City).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Bataan, Metro Manila, Laguna, Rizal, Tarlac, Pampanga, Bulacan, Quezon, Nueva Ecija, Cavite(Amadeo, General Trias, Silang, Bacoor, Carmona, Cavite City, Dasmarinas, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Imus, Kawit, Noveleta, Rosario) and Batangas(Rosario, Lobo, Taysan, San Juan, Tingloy) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Zambales(Masinloc, Botolan, Iba, Palauig, Cabangan, San Felipe, San Narciso, San Marcelino) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

data.text:
Typhoon Ragasa update: @AaronRigsbyOSC and myself successfully made a very last second move to the small town of Ivana, Philippines on Batan Island. A 16KM scooter ride in the dark along a very landslide prone area. There is no turning back to Basco until this storm passes. The power has gone out but still have cell signal. No clue when that will fail but the winds are picking up significantly. We are currently under a Signal 4 advisory for extreme damage to critical infrastructure and vegetation. 

Typhoon Ragasa has expanded its eye into a giant “truck tire” which means the wind field is expanding well beyond the eye. We are only hours away from violent CAT4-5 winds hitting our location. I will update as the day goes on and service allows. 

#typhoon #Ragasa #batanisland #Philippines
